positions.title: Mobile Software Engineer - iOS - Android - React Native
Mobile Software Engineer, Android, iOS
positions.description:
Responsible of the development of the Frequency Android and iOS customer applications. Working closely with back-end team and designers to deliver a ground breaking video application (discontinued in 2016). Design and development of a SDK wrapping Frequency’s technology to let third parties implement with minimal work an end to end Native video solution. The SDK includes the following features: REST API calls, native video playback, advertisement and analytics. This SDK is being used by DirectTV, Liberty Global, Titan, in their customer applications.
DirectTV - Entertainment Extras - Development and software design of a pure javascript application which runs on DirectTV set top boxes.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
Full Stack Project – THE SHARKULATOR - 2017-2018
The SHARKULATOR is an open-source platform that creates ranking among its users by letting them enter any games they play. The idea is based of the Chess World Ranking where every games count towards the global ranking. This principle has been simplified to be applicable for every individual sports or games. It’s a React Native application with a Spring Boot back-end deployed on AWS. The Application is available for Android and iOS.
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.elo.sharkulator
iOS: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/sharkulator/id1376056102?mt=8

positions.title: Android developper
positions.description:

Responsible of the conception and development of a biometric attendance control application for an Android tablet with embedded NFC and fingerprint scanner.
Technology: Android API 15, TazTag API (for NFC & fingerprint Sensor), SQLite, PHP, JSON
